description: This file defines an internal interface IConnectedClientCollection and a sealed class EmptyConnectedClientCollection within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. The interface manages collections of connected clients, providing a version number and a method to retrieve connected client IDs. The class provides a trivial implementation returning static values.

classes.name: IConnectedClientCollection
classes.description: An internal interface representing a collection of currently connected clients, with a version property and a method to retrieve connected client IDs.

classes.name: EmptyConnectedClientCollection
classes.description: A sealed internal class implementing IConnectedClientCollection, representing an empty or static collection with a fixed version and no connected clients.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: A property returning the version of the collection, fixed at 0 in this implementation.

methods.name: GetConnectedClientIds
methods.description: Returns a list of connected client IDs; in this implementation, returns an empty list.
